meta.name: li-audit
meta.description: Post-mortem on what the user has already published - which posts actually worked, why, and what to stop doing. Use when the user pastes their LinkedIn analytics or past posts and asks "what's working", "why did this flop", "read my analytics", "audit my content", or wants to know what to double down on.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析已发布的领英帖子表现,找出哪些内容有效、哪些该停,并指明下一步该加码的方向。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在领英发过不少帖子,却说不清哪些真正有效,想知道接下来该写什么。
copy.tagline_en: Audit posts to find what worked, what flopped, and what to double down on.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've posted on LinkedIn but can't tell what worked or what to write next.

howto.what: 你把已发布的 LinkedIn 帖子或数据导出交给它,它会算出互动率、评论比、触达倍数等指标,排出最好和最差的 5 条帖子,找出共同规律,并给出该停做什么、多做什么的结论。
howto.when: 当你粘贴 LinkedIn 数据或过往帖子,并问「什么有效」「为什么这条没起色」或要求「审计我的内容」等时触发。

say.text: 这是我最近 30 条帖子的互动数据,帮我看看哪些有效
say.note: 它会按互动率排名,列出前 5 和后 5 条

say.text: 这条帖子为什么没人评论?
say.note: 它会对照你账号的其他数据找原因

say.text: 我该停做什么、多做什么?
say.note: 输出 STOP 与 DO MORE 两行结论

howto.what_en: Give it your published LinkedIn posts or analytics export, and it computes engagement rate, comment ratio and reach multiple, ranks your top and bottom 5 posts, finds the pattern, and says what to stop and what to do more of.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste LinkedIn analytics or past posts and ask "what's working", "why did this flop", or to audit your content.

say_en.text: Here are my last 30 posts with engagement data - which ones worked?
say_en.note: It ranks by engagement rate and lists top and bottom 5.

say_en.text: Why did this post get no comments?
say_en.note: It compares it against the rest of your account data.

say_en.text: What should I stop doing and do more of?
say_en.note: It outputs a STOP line and a DO MORE line.
